conversion_notes: Numbered structural equations are normalized to LaTeX in equations.md; document.md carries the argument and the figures.

The long proof-only Itô and jump identities are not re-keyed. The six source pages they occupy are kept as rendered images under source_pages/ and referenced from equations.md, so a disputed step is read off the page rather than off an ambiguous text layer.
The package no longer carries the source PDF or its full 43-page render: the arXiv id plus source_sha256 identify the exact file, which keeps the package at roughly two megabytes.
The calibrated CDX parameters of section 6 are collected in tables.md as Markdown; there are no CSV tables.
Figures 1-19 are PNG crops from source pages 32-41.
